operations.description: Receive webhook events from incident.io (incident/action/follow-up events).

filters.event_type:
Which incident.io webhook event fires this workflow. incident.io delivers every subscribed event to one URL, so this filters the inbound payload by its `event_type`. Choose:
- All events: fire on any delivered event
- Incident created/updated/status updated: public incident lifecycle
- Action created/updated, Follow-up created/updated: post-incident tasks
- Incident membership granted/revoked: responder added/removed
- Private incident created/updated/status updated: private-incident equivalents
Make sure the matching event is enabled in incident.io Settings -> Webhooks.
